players.product: AC-DC power shelves / PSUs and connectivity for AI servers

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K backlog: Bel's backlog of orders totaled $439.1 million at December 31, 2025, up $57.5 million or 15.1% from December 31, 2024. Power Solutions and Protection backlog rose 9.4% on higher demand in the defense and networking end markets; Magnetic Solutions backlog rose 52.3%, primarily due to increased order volume from a large networking customer; Connectivity Solutions backlog rose $21.5 million (19.4%) on commercial aerospace and industrial demand and defense strength through distribution. Backlog was estimated at approximately $452.2 million as of January 31, 2026 versus $388.1 million a year earlier, and management estimates approximately 80%-85% of it will ship by December 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $439.1 million at December 31, 2025 (+15.1%); approximately $452.2 million at January 31, 2026 (vs $388.1 million); Magnetic Solutions backlog +52.3%; 80%-85% to ship by December 31, 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration: during 2025 no direct customer or ultimate end customer exceeded 10% of consolidated net sales (none in 2024 or 2023 either), although Bel says it has experienced significant customer concentrations in prior years.
quarterly_data.figure: no customer above 10% of 2025 net sales

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K segment: Power Solutions and Protection net sales were $356.8M in fiscal 2025 (+45.3% YoY from $245.6M), 53% of net sales, with gross margin of 42.7% versus 42.4%; the segment includes Enercon (80% stake acquired November 2024, a supplier of customized power conversion and networking solutions to aerospace and defense), whose sales were $136.6 million in 2025 versus $20.8 million in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 Power Solutions and Protection $356.8M (+45.3%); gross margin 42.7% (42.4%); Enercon $136.6 million

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K segment: Connectivity Solutions net sales were $232.3M in fiscal 2025 (+5.4% YoY from $220.4M), 34% of net sales, with gross margin of 38.7% versus 37.1%.

10-K segment: Magnetic Solutions (integrated connector modules and discrete Ethernet magnetics for network switches, routers and hubs, plus power transformers) net sales were $86.4M in fiscal 2025 (+25.4% YoY from $68.9M), 13% of net sales, with gross margin of 27.6% versus 25.3%.

10-K materials and supply: lead-times for certain integrated circuits have increased, which Bel believes is primarily driven by AI and the infrastructure necessary to support it; pricing for gold, silver and copper is rising to historical highs. Outstanding purchase orders for raw materials were $81.5 million at December 31, 2025 ($82.2 million a year earlier), of which $79.5 million is expected to be paid in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: raw-material purchase orders $81.5 million (December 31, 2025); $79.5 million payable in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K manufacturing footprint: the majority of Magnetic Solutions manufacturing capacity and supplier base, and a portion of Power Solutions and Protection, is in the PRC; at December 31, 2025, 42% of associates and 56% of owned or leased manufacturing facilities (by square footage) were in the PRC. In late 2025 Bel began transitioning manufacturing from its Pingguo, PRC facility to an outside subcontractor (the 'Pingguo initiative', $1.6 million of restructuring costs in 2025) and moved certain operations from Glen Rock, Pennsylvania to other existing Bel sites. Outstanding purchase orders for capital expenditures were $2.0 million ($4.6 million a year earlier); purchases of property, plant and equipment were $12.0 million in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: PRC: 42% of associates, 56% of manufacturing square footage; Pingguo initiative $1.6 million; capex purchase orders $2.0 million; 2025 capex $12.0 million
